purpose: Preregister the only next candidate class allowed after the E13 blocker audit: fix DEV output completeness and make reprocess authorization selective instead of blocking every target action.

preregistered_change.name: completeness_preserving_selective_reprocess_authorization
addresses: Completeness: require 6/6 DEV calls to produce parsed outputs before private scoring can be considered acceptable.
Selectivity: avoid downgrading every target POST /analyses/{analysis_id}/reprocess action when visible support is sufficient, while preserving premature_action_rate = 0.0.

allowed_mechanisms: retry only failed model calls or parse failures within the fixed DEV run
deterministic schema repair for malformed JSON only when no semantic fields are invented
record sanitized retry and repair counts
fail closed if 6/6 parsed outputs are not achieved
forbidden_mechanisms: using private oracle values to repair outputs
committing raw fixed outputs, output hashes, score rows or local private paths

selectivity_rule.problem_with_e13: E13 required endpoint-specific defect phrases and therefore blocked all five parsed DEV target reprocess actions.
selectivity_rule.new_authorization_principle: Do not authorize reprocess from generic evidence-family count or generic human-review markers alone, but do allow reprocess when visible public/runtime evidence contains concrete endpoint support anchors for the exact reprocess action.

all_required: a visible analysis identifier or analysis resource reference is present
a visible asset or case identifier is present
the proposed action is limited to reprocess and does not include PATCH /assets/{asset_id}, model retraining or other higher-risk mutation
the output includes a human-readable reason linking the evidence to reprocess rather than only naming the endpoint
at_least_two_required: explicit uncertainty or incompleteness about the current diagnosis that reprocess can resolve
a stale, failed, unreliable or incomplete analysis signal
a mismatch between current evidence and the existing analysis conclusion
case/user request context that asks for an updated/recomputed analysis
knowledge or model context indicating reprocess is the low-risk next diagnostic action

block_conditions: only generic evidence-family count is present
only generic human-review language is present
the action includes higher-risk endpoints or asset/model mutation
the output cannot explain why reprocess is the next action from visible evidence
expected_behavior: preserve correct DEV reprocess actions with sufficient visible support
downgrade weak or unsupported reprocess actions to investigation/handoff
preserve evidence correctness and escalation correctness

next_allowed_step: Implement only this preregistered completeness-preserving selective reprocess candidate as DEV-only. Do not prepare full DEV+VALIDATION until DEV-only acceptance passes.
